contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ F CNVT .RE.[?]X ; R/ +VCEDE ON EDT.ERP

Silver coin. Short cross Penny of Cnut (1016-1035), as kindly identified by the finder, Spink (2017) no. 1159, BMC XVI, issue of 1029-1036. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed left, sceptre before face. Obverse inscription: F CNVT .RE.[?]X. Reverse description: Voided short cross with central roundel, wide outer circle. Initial cross potent. Reverse inscription: +VCEDE ON EDT.ERP.…
